agent-task create.reason: gh 2.102 rejects a GHES host before submitting a cloud agent task. The harness's rc/contains class records this client-side refusal, not an invented HTTP 404. Inline/file/stdin, agent, branch, follow, missing and private repositories all remain behind this guard; successful cloud sessions cannot be provisioned on Codeyard.

expected.contains: agent tasks are not supported on this host

agent-task list.reason: The CLI rejects GHES before listing cloud agent tasks, including formatted output. This is a tested client-side host refusal, not a skipped command or a claim that the server returned HTTP 404. Browser mode is waived separately.

expected.contains: agent tasks are not supported on this host

agent-task view.reason: The CLI refuses GHES before looking up an agent session or following logs. The rc/contains classification describes that client guard; a successful session, authorization decision or log stream requires GitHub's cloud service.

expected.contains: agent tasks are not supported on this host

attestation download.reason: gh attestation rejects GHES at host validation, before digest lookup. Test this clean refusal for the download flags. Codeyard actually implements repository attestation REST reads: adjacent real-gh api assertions separately check empty success, missing/private 404 and malformed digest 422, rather than wrongly expecting all attestation routes to be unsupported.

expected.contains: gh attestation does not currently support GHES

attestation trusted-root.reason: The CLI's GHES host guard prevents default and custom TUF retrieval. No public Sigstore/TUF mirror is contacted and no fake trust root is accepted as verified. The custom mirror argument points only at the disposable test host.

expected.contains: gh attestation does not currently support GHES

attestation verify.reason: gh refuses GHES before verification, even for local bundle/trust-root arguments. Test independent policy/output flags against that refusal and reject a local-file/OCI-only combination without contacting a registry. Successful cryptographic verification and OCI registry authentication cannot be supplied by the harness's forge fixtures.

expected.contains: gh attestation does not currently support GHES

codespace code.reason: Codespaces requires a github.com codespace OAuth login, not the GHES PAT provisioned by this harness. Assert the noninteractive auth refusal for selectors/insiders, then use real gh api to assert the live GHES route's 404. Supplying cloud credentials would target the wrong server.

codespace cp.reason: The CLI requires cloud Codespaces authentication before copying or opening SSH. Check the guard with real local source files, copy directions, recursive/expand/profile modes and selectors; separately check the live GHES HTTP boundary. No remote shell is started.

codespace create.reason: No github.com Codespaces OAuth identity is provisioned: creation flags and missing repository selection stop at the client auth guard. An adjacent real-gh POST checks Codeyard's clean GHES HTTP 404. Successful machines cannot exist on GHES.

codespace delete.reason: Cloud OAuth is required before named, bulk, age, owner or organization deletion. Test that refusal (including a second-account organization selection) and the live GHES DELETE 404; do not create or delete real cloud workspaces.

codespace edit.reason: Name/machine edits and selection modes require cloud OAuth before reaching a service. Assert the auth refusal plus Codeyard's actual GHES PATCH 404. Rename and resize success cannot be provisioned on this host.

codespace jupyter.reason: Jupyter requires a running cloud codespace and github.com OAuth; the CLI refuses the harness's GHES-only login first. Exercise all selectors and the live GHES GET 404 without launching a browser or Jupyter process.

codespace list.reason: User/repository/org listing and output modes encounter the cloud OAuth guard before HTTP. Test the refusal and separately assert live user/org Codespaces REST 404s. The organization/user selection uses a second harness account, not a cloud subscription.

codespace logs.reason: Snapshot/follow and selector modes require cloud OAuth. Assert a bounded immediate auth failure and a live GHES GET 404, not an invented successful log stream.

codespace ports forward.reason: Forwarding requires cloud OAuth and a cloud tunnel. Test auth refusal with loopback/all-interface flags and selectors plus the actual GHES 404. Port zero avoids reserving a fixed local port if selection ever proceeds; no successful tunnel can be hosted by GHES.

codespace ports visibility.reason: Public/private/org visibility modes and selectors require cloud OAuth. Assert the CLI refusal and live GHES GET 404. The forge has no forwarded Codespaces ports whose visibility can be changed.

codespace rebuild.reason: Incremental/full rebuild and selectors stop at the cloud auth guard. Assert that clean failure and the live GHES HTTP boundary; no rebuild RPC is available on GHES.

codespace ssh.reason: SSH, config generation, debug/profile/port and selectors all require a github.com Codespaces login. Assert the auth refusal and live GHES GET 404; a successful SSH connection requires an external cloud machine and is deliberately not emulated.

codespace stop.reason: Named/filtered and organization second-user stops require cloud OAuth. Assert the client refusal and actual GHES POST 404; Codeyard cannot own a running cloud codespace.

codespace view.reason: Details, output modes and selectors stop at cloud OAuth validation. Assert the refusal and the live GHES GET 404 instead of treating a nonexistent cloud machine as a successful details fixture.

copilot.reason: --remove manages the per-account downloaded CLI on disk; test removal when absent. Bare copilot would execute an arbitrary PATH binary or offer to download and execute cloud-distributed software, not call Codeyard. No such binary, cloud license or interactive installation is provisioned. Never launch it in the sweep.

extension browse.reason: The browse TUI needs a controlling terminal, while ctx.gh deliberately uses pipes. Assert the clean terminal refusal in default, accessible-column and debug modes; do not fabricate keystrokes or a TTY transport.

extension create.reason: Create uniquely named script, Go and other precompiled scaffolds and inspect generated files; reject an invalid precompiled type. A live authenticated account is available for scaffold owner resolution.

extension exec.reason: Execute only a test-owned local shell extension, assert argument forwarding and missing-extension failure, and remove its registration in finally. No downloaded extension code is executed.

extension install.reason: Install a local test-owned executable, check duplicate/force behavior, then request unique missing GHES repositories with normal, pinned and forced modes and assert actual HTTP 404.

extension list.reason: Listing reads per-account local extension registrations. Assert presence/path after installing a unique local extension and absence after removing it, without relying on an empty shared account.

extension remove.reason: Remove a unique local extension registration, assert its source remains and the listing loses it, then check repeated removal's diagnostic. No forge HTTP operation exists for this command.

extension search.reason: A fresh live repository tagged gh-extension must appear in JSON, jq and template searches; absent queries exercise license, sort, order and limit modes. Browser launching is waived.

extension upgrade.reason: Local symlink extensions cannot be remotely upgraded. Assert that diagnostic for named dry-run/force and all dry-run/force, and reject an absent name. Successful remote upgrades need a separately published executable/release and would download code; no installed third-party extensions are modified.

preview prompter.reason: This is a local interactive prompt demonstration, not an HTTP command. Request an input prompt with closed piped stdin and assert a clean prompt/EOF refusal under a short deadline; no TTY is fabricated.

skill install.reason: Remote GHES repositories, including missing/private repositories owned by another account, encounter the explicit Skills host guard. Also exercise real local copying, forced replacement and hidden directory discovery into invocation-owned custom paths. Successful GitHub cloud skill retrieval is not available on GHES.

skill list.reason: Enumerate real local SKILL.md fixtures and assert name/path/pinned JSON, jq and template results, empty user-scope agent results and invalid scope rejection. The command scans local files, not forge routes.

skill preview.reason: GitHub Skills explicitly rejects GHES before remote discovery/content fetching, including hidden-directory and missing-repository modes. Assert that guard, not a network/proxy failure or a made-up preview.

expected.contains: GitHub Skills does not currently support GitHub Enterprise Server

skill publish.reason: Validate a local skill tree with dry-run (including a tag), run fix and reject invalid frontmatter; actual tagged publishing is checked for the explicit GHES Skills refusal. A cloud release is not fabricated and no local git commit is made.

skill search.reason: The Skills GHES guard prevents code-search requests; assert it for normal, owner/paged/limited and JSON/jq/template modes. A GitHub cloud code-search index cannot be substituted for the live Codeyard server.

expected.contains: GitHub Skills does not currently support GitHub Enterprise Server

skill update.reason: Assert scanning an invocation-owned empty directory is a read-only no-op in normal, all, dry-run, force and unpin combinations. Also check metadata-free local skills are not silently rewritten. Successful remote updating requires GitHub cloud source metadata/host support, not supplied by GHES or by fabricated cloud credentials.
